items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1960-10-27
items.q: Joe Oliver went up there and this boy, Louis Armstrong, he went up there and we all went up the same time.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. That's where I registered to go to the Army in 1917 up there. You were what?

I registered to go to the Army in 1917 up there. And Joe was there when you registered? Mm-hmm. I went up there playing at the same time. Joe Oliver went up there and this boy, Louis Armstrong, he went up there and we all went up the same time. Joe Oliver got to play at one of the biggest nightclub I think was around in that section. Around the state in the 35th and around there in 47. He got to be a famous man. The first time he went up there the fellas were kidding me, you know. The boys coming out there from…
Did you ever go to the Dream Land or the Royal Garden or the Lincoln Garden or vacation any other places in Chicago? No.
